headline: China Confirms Three Ships Passed Through Strait
summary: China confirmed that three ships passed through the Strait of Hormuz amid a crisis affecting global oil flows and tanker operations. Coverage tracks the impact on shipping.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so disruptions there directly affect crude prices and shipping costs. Tanker traffic is a key indicator of supply security.
why_moved: The crisis around the Strait of Hormuz is affecting global oil flows and tanker operations, which is the kind of supply disruption that moves crude prices.
